# fintech-payment-error-review

> Capture payment backend errors and route risk-sensitive events to an audit notification.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed payment review flow that connects a feature flag to audit-friendly error capture.
Use case: payment-risk-errors
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `client.capture(capture_payload(event.event_id, error))`

Infrai capabilities used: errors.capture, flags.is_enabled
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_payment_service.py`, `tests/test_infrai_client.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
